card.name: Dashes in ranges and page citations
card.fires_on: En dashes that join two numbers in a range, such as temperatures or class grades, and the abbreviation "pp" before a page range in reference lists.

modes.label: Dash inside a numeric range
modes.description: An en dash between or just before numbers giving a range of values.

modes.label: Page abbreviation in citations
modes.description: The abbreviation pp before a page number range in a bibliography entry.

card.writes: It promotes dash tokens and suppresses hyphen, plus, and comparison symbols, so the next mark is a range dash.
card.plain: It fires where a dash will link two numbers in a range, or where pp introduces page numbers in a reference.
